<MethodEndpoint method={'post'} path={'/v1/onboardings'} context={'endpoint'}></MethodEndpoint>

Creates an onboarding on the latest published revision of the workflow and enters its initial step. The response carries the id every other flow route is keyed by. Every agreement family the workflow declares is linked to it as pending, at that family's latest published version; a family with no published version refuses the start.
